item.title: H T Parekh Foundation to Host Inaugural Harsha Parekh Librarian Awards in Mumbai
item.description: The H T Parekh Foundation will host the inaugural Harsha Parekh Librarian Awards in Mumbai on February 28, 2026, recognising children’s librarians and library leaders across India.

item.title: Haldiram Snacks Food Pvt. Ltd. Appoints Annu Gupta as CEO – International Business
item.description: Haldiram Snacks Food Pvt. Ltd. has appointed former Britannia executive Annu Gupta as CEO – International Business, marking a new phase in its global expansion plans.

item.title: Government of Uttar Pradesh Signs MoU with AVW Global to Bring Back MotoGP Races and Asia Road Racing Championship
item.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has signed an MoU with AVW Global to revive MotoGP and the Asia Road Racing Championship at Buddh International Circuit, aiming to restore India’s presence on the global racing calendar.

item.title: NCPA Soulful Blues 2026 Returns with Two Evenings of Contemporary Blues Led by Shakura S’Aida and Sugaray Rayford
item.description: NCPA Soulful Blues 2026 will bring Shakura S’Aida and Sugaray Rayford to the Tata Theatre for two evenings of contemporary blues on March 28 and 29, 2026.

item.title: India’s Vice President Inaugurates USISPF Tourism Leadership Summit 2026 in New Delhi, Highlights U.S.–India Travel Ties
item.description: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the USISPF Tourism Leadership Summit 2026 in New Delhi, highlighting tourism’s economic and diplomatic value and the growing U.S.–India travel corridor.

item.title: Delhi Jewellery & Gem Fair Signature 2026 to Host 150+ Exhibitors at Bharat Mandapam from 28 Feb
item.description: DJGF Signature 2026 will take place from 28 February to 2 March at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, bringing together 150+ exhibitors and over 7,000 expected trade buyers.

item.title: Communique India Crafts Immersive ‘Beyond Limits’ Launch for Tata Punch.ev
item.description: Communique India unveiled the Tata Punch.ev through an immersive launch event built around the “Beyond Limits” campaign, featuring a dramatic LED monolith reveal and interactive product zones.

item.title: CAB Experiences Delivers Bharat Pavilion at AI Impact Summit in Delhi Within 10-Day Turnaround
item.description: CAB Experiences delivered the Bharat Pavilion at the AI Impact Summit in Delhi within a 10-day lead time, showcasing India’s grassroots-focused AI initiatives in the presence of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and 22 heads of state.

item.title: Beatit Entertainment Executes Hyundai Branding Across Eight Stadiums for ICC T20 World Cup
item.description: Beatit Entertainment executed end-to-end Hyundai branding across eight stadiums in India and Sri Lanka during the ICC T20 Men’s World Cup, managing planning through on-ground implementation.

item.title: The Gypsy Travel Festival Draws 7,000+ Visitors Over Two Days at Jio World Drive
item.description: The Gypsy Travel Festival drew over 7,000 visitors to Jio World Drive for two days of immersive travel experiences, cultural showcases and business engagement, organisers said.
